purpose: Stop products from being sold before the business has proof, supplier confidence, pricing, market eligibility, and visual accuracy.

definitions.gate: A required checkpoint before a product moves forward.
definitions.override: A manual exception approved by the owner and recorded with a reason.
definitions.market_eligibility: Whether a product can be sold in a specific country.

gates.pass_condition: Product candidate exists with store_id, category, demand signals, expected customer problem, and first decision.
Product file ID exists and missing evidence is listed.
Primary supplier route and backup route are recorded.
Sample was received, inspected, photographed, and marked passed or retest-approved.
Product is approved, affiliate-only, prepare-only, or blocked for US with reason.
Product is approved, affiliate-only, prepare-only, or blocked for UK with reason.
HS code, country of origin, product category, and declared value are recorded where needed.
USD and GBP target prices, landed cost estimate, margin status, and price floor are reviewed.
Approved claims and blocked claims are stored separately.
Desktop and mobile product page, cart, checkout, and email surfaces are checked.

override_rule: Overrides must include owner approval, date, reason, market, product_file_id, and risk note.
